name: Unicode Emoji
summary: A set of small colour pictures that sit in text as characters: yellow faces, hands, food and flags. Japanese phone makers drew the first sets; Unicode 6.0 added them to the standard in 2010.

philosophy.core_thesis: A picture becomes a character: the same small yellow face can enter any text on any device.
design_principles: Draw each glyph on a square field with a 1:1 ratio and set it at the line height of the text, 1.2em.
Use a round yellow face (#FFC83D) with a 1px darker rim, two simple eyes and a mouth of one curve.
Fill shapes with flat colour and one soft highlight; keep the outline to 1px or none.
Show a skin tone with 5 swatches from #FADCBC to #3D2B1F as a modifier row under a hand glyph.
Set the glyph in a picker grid of 8 columns with 8px gutters and a tab row of 9 categories.
Keep the text font neutral and round, so that the glyph is the only colour in the line.
Let the glyph be 1.0em to 1.2em in text, and 32px to 48px in a picker.
anti_patterns: Glyphs drawn at a different size from the line
Photographic emoji with realistic skin and lighting
Emoji set on a dark gradient that hides the yellow
Custom emoji with no shared base shape
Mixed glyph sets from different vendors in one line

layout.grid_mechanics: A picker grid of 8 columns with 8px gutters and 44px cells; text lines on a 4px baseline.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Glyphs sit on the text baseline; the picker is flush-left with a centred category row.
layout.container_geometry: Cards and keys with a 12px radius; the picker cell is a 44px square with an 8px radius.

font_pairings.note: Rounded open faces; glyphs come from Noto Color Emoji (OFL).
A warmer display face for a playful page.

hierarchy_rules: Use 1 display size of 32px or more and keep body text at 16px.
Keep a glyph at 1.2em beside text and at 48px as a hero.
Set category labels in 12px at 600 weight.

color.palette_structure: White ground with one warm yellow and one blue; the glyphs supply every other colour.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on white holds 15:1; yellow is a fill with dark text on it, not a text colour.
color.surface_treatment: Flat white and cream fields; the glyph carries all the colour.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft top-left light inside each glyph; a 6px soft shadow under cards.

materiality.surface_simulation: Small glossy plastic discs: flat fills with one highlight.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px rim in sand on cards; none on glyphs.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 6px blur shadow at 12% opacity for pickers and sheets.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Colour glyphs of 1:1 ratio; faces, hands, food, flags, objects in 9 categories.
ornamentation_details.illustration: The glyph set itself: faces with 2 simple eyes and 1 mouth curve.

motion.transition_physics: Glyphs pop in with a scale from 0.8 to 1.0 in 200ms; a reaction chip bounces once.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales the glyph to 1.25 in 120ms; active scales to 0.9.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a warm, quick, shared tone in a text line.

avoid_when: The brand needs a strict, formal tone.
The page needs a custom mascot that no vendor draws.
The output channel has no colour emoji font.

modifiers.how: Replace the glyph with a large drawn character of 120px and a hand-lettered word.
Replace the flat face with a rendered head with soft light and a 20px depth shadow.
Replace each glyph with a text face of 3 to 8 characters in one ink colour.

pack.why: A filled, rounded family sits close to the flat colour glyphs of an emoji set.

ground.why: An emoji sits on a plain light field, so the yellow and the other glyph colours carry the page.
